messages:
maria-peopleops: quick q — we have an internal lateral (IC -> IC) moving teams, manager wants to bump comp and change band effective next pay period. what are the steps to get this into payroll without delaying salary start?

jake-engineering-manager: thanks — candidate is sam (IC, SDE II -> SDE III equivalent). manager submitted PRD + manager approval in Lattice last night. do we need a separate evidence packet?

maria-peopleops: short answer: yes, we need the manager evidence summary + the approval routing. if comp increase > 10% we need exec signoff per policy. also need effective date pinned for payroll cutover.

leo-payroll: timeline check — payroll cutoff for next pay period is EOD Thu (files locked Fri 2am UTC). if you want change reflected next pay, approvals must be finalized by Thu noon PST ideally so we can stage the file and do validations.

anya-peopleops: maria — please attach the manager summary here (one paragraph), and confirm new comp, new band, and requested effective date. i'll start the exec loop if >10%.

jake-engineering-manager: manager summary below: "Sam promoted for ownership on infra feature X, comparable market comp at SDE III, target comp $165,000, current $150,000, 10% bump. Request effective 2026-04-01."

maria-peopleops: thanks. 10% is right on the threshold — leo, does payroll treat 10% as auto or needs manual exec approval when equal?

leo-payroll: our rule: >=10% triggers review. in practice we require sponsor (director+) signoff + people-ops review. can run manual exception if finance ok.

finance-ops: flagged — we need cost center code and run-rate impact for Q2. @jake-engineering-manager please provide cost_center: ENG-PLAT and headcount bucket (replacement vs add).

jake-engineering-manager: cost_center: ENG-PLAT, headcount: replacement (no net new).

maria-peopleops: ok i'll kick off exec loop now. ETA A.M. tomorrow for signoff, then payroll can ingest. if exec signoff isn't back by Thu noon PST payroll will push to next cycle.

payroll-bot: Payroll intake received: change request 2226001234 — status: staging. Please ensure approvals attached as PDFs to the HR system: /hr/comp_changes/2226001234.pdf

leo-payroll: also note: for cross-border hires we'd need local statutory prorate rules. this is US-to-US internal so standard proration applies (pro-rate by days if effective date not first of month). since requested 2026-04-01, we can do full-month.

anya-peopleops: two action items for manager: 1) attach exec-approved signoff email to Lattice update, 2) confirm offer/comp letter update to employee before change goes live.

jake-engineering-manager: ack — will attach signoff and update sam today.

maria-peopleops: final note: if compensation change affects equity banding or refresh cadence, alert comp-planning (cc: @finance-ops) — equity admin lead will need to adjust grant schedule.

finance-ops: noted — if equity schedule change needed open ticket to comp-admin.

maria-peopleops: great, keeping as short thread so we have a single source. i'll update once exec signoff received. :thumbsup:

jake-engineering-manager: thanks! :raised_hands:

payroll-bot: Payroll ingestion complete for staged items pending approvals. reference id: PR-2026-7221.
